column1: # Ivan hears the Bloom: his lines in the Chapter 3 scenes.

column3: She enjoyed that, Isaac. I\ncould feel it. She wants us\nto be afraid.{end_wait}
I can hear them, Isaac.\nNot every voice clearly.\nThey're awake, terrified.{end_wait}
I can't. It keeps getting\nlouder, and I think it's\nbecause of the lighthouse.{end_wait}

Mia, I can hear them down
there. Some are praying,
and some are changing.{page_break}Every minute we spend
arguing, there are fewer
of them left.{end_wait}
Mia is trying to hide how\nmuch that encounter shook\nher. We should stay close.{end_wait}
